sentences.text: Phocaeicola dorei is a species detected in human stool metagenomes, where it was reported to correlate negatively with its sister species Phocaeicola vulgatus.
In mice on a high-fat diet, a strain called a next-generation probiotic candidate, Phocaeicola dorei YGMCC0564, was reported to attenuate body weight gain, dyslipidemia and hyperglycemia.
That study also reported reduced hepatic steatosis and gluconeogenic gene expression and improved insulin resistance in the mice given this strain.
In a mouse model of steatotic liver disease, the prebiotic pectic oligosaccharides were reported to enrich a core microbiota dominated by Phocaeicola dorei and reactivate its vitamin B7 biosynthesis.
